description: Initial calibration full-row locator views plus approximate pitch-based crop placement were used; per-control independent full-group locations were not all frozen. Reviewer found C140, C183, V07 truncated required outer strokes. Frozen crops were retained; no posthoc acceptance retest.
blinding: Metadata sample labels previously exposed; opaque panels not strong blinding. Independent reviewer also read label-bearing crop metadata and viewed whole-image source before close-up phases.
measurement_limit: Operator crest heights rounded from a representative visual ratio near 0.75, not independent traced landmarks; reviewer gives intervals.
consequence: Do not claim independently passed validation or any new target source reading.
